gloss: double speed; fast speed; multiplied speed

definitions.explanation: A rate of playback or operation that is a multiple of the normal speed. Often used with a number prefix to specify the multiplier.

examples.japanese: {動画|どうが}を{倍速|ばいそく}で{見|み}る。
examples.english: To watch a video at double speed.

examples.japanese: {倍速|ばいそく}{再生|さいせい}にすると{時間|じかん}の{節約|せつやく}になる。
{講義|こうぎ}の{録画|ろくが}を1.5{倍速|ばいそく}で{聞|き}いて{復習|ふくしゅう}した。
examples.english: I reviewed the recorded lecture by listening at 1.5 times speed.

notes:
{倍|ばい} (double, times) + {速|そく} (speed). Very commonly used in the context of video and audio playback. On its own, {倍速|ばいそく} usually means double (2x) speed, but it is frequently combined with a number to specify the exact multiplier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {倍速|ばいそく}{再生|さいせい} — fast playback
- {倍速|ばいそく}で{見|み}る — watch at double speed
- 1.5{倍速|ばいそく} — 1.5 times speed
- 2{倍速|ばいそく} — double speed
- 3{倍速|ばいそく} — triple speed

CULTURAL NOTE:
Watching videos and lectures at {倍速|ばいそく} has become extremely common in Japan, especially among younger generations. The term {倍速|ばいそく}{視聴|しちょう} (fast-speed viewing) is used in media discussions about changing consumption habits.
